messages:
alexa: Heads-up: CI red on hosted-integration suite. Failures across auth, streaming handshake, and tool-call integration. Started ~10m ago. Anyone on call can take a look?

ci-bot: CI update: job hosted-integration/merge #842 failed (tests: 23 failing). Link: https://ci/internal/12345 :x:

miguel: I'm on call. Looking now. Can you paste the failing test names?

alexa: Top fails: auth/session_token_test.py::test_refresh_token, streaming/stream_handshake_test.py::test_chunked_start, tools/tool_call_integration_test.py::test_schema_mismatch. Logs attached below.

alexa: ```
auth error: 401 unauthorized - token validation failed (kid=r1)
streaming error: handshake failed - unexpected header: x-client-proto
tools error: schema mismatch - expected v1, got v2 payload
```

devon: Seeing 401s from auth service when validating token with jwks. Also some 400s in streaming: 'unexpected header: x-client-proto' — looks like header mismatch between proxy and runtime.

samir: Could be auth rotation yesterday? We deployed key-rotation patch to hosted-auth at 02:07 UTC. @devon can you check jwks endpoint serving the right kid?

devon: curl https://hosted-auth.internal/.well-known/jwks.json -> returns kty/alg keys, but kid list doesn't include kid 'r1' that the tokens use. Suspect propagation issue to edge caches.

miguel: If token validation failing, that would also break streaming handshake since the handshake exchanges a signed session. Reverting key-rotation? We can roll back on hosted-auth to pre-rotation tag.

alexa: Can we try rerunning the specific jobs first? If it's propagation you'll see same failures. @ci-bot can you re-run those failed jobs with --rerun-failed

ci-bot: Re-run requested by miguel. queued re-run for hosted-integration/merge #842 -> jobs: auth, streaming, tool-call. URL: https://ci/internal/12345/rerun

devon: Also, tool-call test failing has schema mismatch: payload v2 vs expected v1. Logs show Accept-Version: 1 in test harness but runtime returned v2. Maybe some service started defaulting to Accept-Version: 2 after config toggle.

alexa: Great catch. That would cause tool-call integration issues independent of auth. For triage: miguel -> auth rollback / check jwks; devon -> streaming proxy headers; samir -> tool service version flag. Ping here when you have updates.

miguel: Rolling back hosted-auth to tag v2026-03-16-rollback now. ETA ~5m.

oncall-rotation: Note: if rollback doesn't help, request a bisect: we have the commit range from yesterday's deploy: 6 commits to check. Use /bisect-hosted script.

ci-bot: Re-run finished: auth job still failing 401, streaming and tool-call passed. auth job: https://ci/internal/12345/6789

miguel: Rollback didn't change jwks cache in edge proxies. Cache TTL is 15m — need to purge edge cache. Purging now.

devon: Streaming proxy header mismatch is fixed after we reloaded nginx config on edge-1. Tool-call issue fixed earlier by Samir's feature-flag revert.

samir: Reverted feature flag for tool-service. Tests passed in rerun. I'll follow up to add an interop test for Accept-Version header.

alexa: Thanks all. Action items: miguel to confirm auth tests pass after cache purge, samir to add interop test, devon to add header regression test. I'll update the incident note. :thumbsup:

miguel: Auth tests now green after cache purge. All integration jobs passed. Marking thread resolved.

alexa: Resolved. Adding postmortem reminder.
